name: agile-agents-core
description: Agentic Agile Harness for GitHub Copilot CLI — an RPI (Research, Plan, Implement, Review) pipeline of 12 specialist agents (1 supervisor, 3 authors, 5 reviewers, plus a backlog-manager, a bootstrapper and a capability-scout) with up-front concept + decision conformance (arc42/C4 and ADRs where the project uses them), multi-lens review, and an eval/cost layer. Language, IaC, and tracker specifics ship as companion agile-agents-* plugins.
